datasets.name: 860fcda0
queryLines:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    logical_table_key,
    total_columns,
    table_completeness_pct,
    is_structurally_compliant,
    maturity_tier,
    ROUND(100.0 * (total_columns - unowned_count) / NULLIF(total_columns, 0), 1) AS pct_owned,
    ROUND(100.0 * (total_columns - uncertified_count) / NULLIF(total_columns, 0), 1) AS pct_certified,
    ROUND(100.0 * (total_columns - pii_non_compliant_count) / NULLIF(total_columns, 0), 1) AS pct_pii_compliant,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY table_completeness_pct DESC) AS rank_completeness,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY is_structurally_compliant DESC) AS rank_structural,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pii_non_compliant_count ASC) AS rank_pii,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY unowned_count ASC) AS rank_unowned,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY uncertified_count ASC) AS rank_uncertified
  FROM metadata_governance.gold.table_governance_summary
)
SELECT
  logical_table_key,
  total_columns,
  ROUND((rank_completeness + rank_structural + rank_pii + rank_unowned + rank_uncertified) / 5.0, 1) AS avg_governance_rank,
  table_completeness_pct,
  pct_owned,
  pct_certified,
  pct_pii_compliant,
  is_structurally_compliant,
  maturity_tier
FROM ranked
ORDER BY avg_governance_rank DESC

datasets.name: 10bb0761
queryLines:
WITH db_level AS (
  SELECT
    database_name,
    SUM(total_tables) AS total_tables,
    SUM(total_columns) AS total_columns,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_completeness_pct), 1) AS avg_completeness_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(pct_structurally_compliant), 1) AS pct_structurally_compliant,
    SUM(total_unowned_columns) AS total_unowned_columns,
    SUM(total_uncertified_columns) AS total_uncertified_columns,
    SUM(total_pii_noncompliant) AS total_pii_noncompliant
  FROM metadata_governance.gold.database_governance_summary
  GROUP BY database_name
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    database_name,
    total_tables,
    total_columns,
    avg_completeness_pct,
    pct_structurally_compliant,
    ROUND(100.0 * (total_columns - total_unowned_columns) / NULLIF(total_columns, 0), 1) AS pct_owned,
    ROUND(100.0 * (total_columns - total_uncertified_columns) / NULLIF(total_columns, 0), 1) AS pct_certified,
    ROUND(100.0 * (total_columns - total_pii_noncompliant) / NULLIF(total_columns, 0), 1) AS pct_pii_compliant,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_completeness_pct DESC) AS rank_completeness,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pct_structurally_compliant DESC) AS rank_structural,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_pii_noncompliant ASC) AS rank_pii,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_unowned_columns ASC) AS rank_unowned,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_uncertified_columns ASC) AS rank_uncertified
  FROM db_level
)
SELECT
  database_name,
  total_columns,
  ROUND((rank_completeness + rank_structural + rank_pii + rank_unowned + rank_uncertified) / 5.0, 1) AS avg_governance_rank,
  avg_completeness_pct,
  pct_owned,
  pct_certified,
  pct_pii_compliant,
  pct_structurally_compliant
FROM ranked
ORDER BY avg_governance_rank DESC

datasets.name: 3aef6650
queryLines:
SELECT
  COUNT(*)                                  AS total_tables,
  SUM(total_columns)                        AS total_columns,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT database_name) FROM metadata_governance.gold.database_governance_summary) AS total_databases,
  ROUND(AVG(table_completeness_pct), 1)     AS avg_table_completeness_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_structurally_compliant THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_structurally_compliant,
  ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(total_columns) - SUM(unowned_count)) / NULLIF(SUM(total_columns), 0), 1) AS pct_owned,
  ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(total_columns) - SUM(uncertified_count)) / NULLIF(SUM(total_columns), 0), 1) AS pct_certified,
  ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(total_columns) - SUM(pii_non_compliant_count)) / NULLIF(SUM(total_columns), 0), 1) AS pct_pii_compliant
FROM metadata_governance.gold.table_governance_summary

datasets.name: 7fd58c4e
queryLines:
SELECT DISTINCT flag_type
FROM (
  SELECT 'Low Maturity' AS flag_type
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Structurally Non-Compliant'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'PII Non-Compliant'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Unowned'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Uncertified'

datasets.name: 64fd54d2
queryLines:
WITH flagged AS (
  SELECT logical_table_key, table_name, schema_name, database_name, 'Low Maturity' AS flag_type
  FROM metadata_governance.gold.table_governance_summary
  WHERE maturity_tier = 'Low'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT logical_table_key, table_name, schema_name, database_name, 'Structurally Non-Compliant' AS flag_type
  FROM metadata_governance.gold.table_governance_summary
  WHERE is_structurally_compliant = false

  UNION ALL

  SELECT logical_table_key, table_name, schema_name, database_name, 'PII Non-Compliant' AS flag_type
  FROM metadata_governance.gold.table_governance_summary
  WHERE pii_non_compliant_count > 0

  UNION ALL

  SELECT logical_table_key, table_name, schema_name, database_name, 'Unowned' AS flag_type
  FROM metadata_governance.gold.table_governance_summary
  WHERE unowned_count > 0

  UNION ALL

  SELECT logical_table_key, table_name, schema_name, database_name, 'Uncertified' AS flag_type
  FROM metadata_governance.gold.table_governance_summary
  WHERE uncertified_count > 0
)
SELECT * FROM flagged
WHERE flag_type = :flag_type

datasets.name: 72bb4ea7
queryLines:
WITH selected AS (
  SELECT
    'Completeness %' AS metric_name,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_completeness_pct), 1) AS database_selected
  FROM
    metadata_governance.gold.database_governance_summary
  WHERE
    database_name = :selected_database
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'Structural Compliance %',
    ROUND(AVG(pct_structurally_compliant), 1)
  FROM
    metadata_governance.gold.database_governance_summary
  WHERE
    database_name = :selected_database
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'Owned %',
    ROUND(
      100.0 * (SUM(total_columns) - SUM(total_unowned_columns)) / NULLIF(SUM(total_columns), 0),
      1
    )
  FROM
    metadata_governance.gold.database_governance_summary
  WHERE
    database_name = :selected_database
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'Certified %',
    ROUND(
      100.0 * (SUM(total_columns) - SUM(total_uncertified_columns)) / NULLIF(SUM(total_columns), 0),
      1
    )
  FROM
    metadata_governance.gold.database_governance_summary
  WHERE
    database_name = :selected_database
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'PII Compliant %',
    ROUND(
      100.0 * (SUM(total_columns) - SUM(total_pii_noncompliant)) / NULLIF(SUM(total_columns), 0),
      1
    )
  FROM
    metadata_governance.gold.database_governance_summary
  WHERE
    database_name = :selected_database
),
overall AS (
  SELECT
    'Completeness %' AS metric_name,
    ROUND(AVG(table_completeness_pct), 1) AS overall_avg
  FROM
    metadata_governance.gold.table_governance_summary
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'Structural Compliance %',
    ROUND(
      100.0
        * SUM(
          CASE
            WHEN is_structurally_compliant THEN 1
            ELSE 0
          END
        )
        / COUNT(*),
      1
    )
  FROM
    metadata_governance.gold.table_governance_summary
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'Owned %',
    ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(total_columns) - SUM(unowned_count)) / NULLIF(SUM(total_columns), 0), 1)
  FROM
    metadata_governance.gold.table_governance_summary
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'Certified %',
    ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(total_columns) - SUM(uncertified_count)) / NULLIF(SUM(total_columns), 0), 1)
  FROM
    metadata_governance.gold.table_governance_summary
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'PII Compliant %',
    ROUND(
      100.0 * (SUM(total_columns) - SUM(pii_non_compliant_count)) / NULLIF(SUM(total_columns), 0),
      1
    )
  FROM
    metadata_governance.gold.table_governance_summary
)
SELECT
  s.metric_name,
  s.database_selected,
  o.overall_avg
FROM
  selected s
    JOIN overall o
      ON s.metric_name = o.metric_name
